The Trojans were led by 11th-year head coach [[Andy Enfield]] and played their home games at the [[Galen Center]] for the 17th season in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 15–18, 8–12 in Pac-12 play to finish in a three-way tie for eighth place. As the No. 8 seed in the Pac-12 tournament, they defeated Washington in the first round before losing to Arizona. On April 1, 2024, head coach Andy Enfield left the school to become the head coach at [[SMU Mustangs men's basketball|SMU]].{{Cite web |date=2024-04-02 |title=SMU hires Andy Enfield: USC coach leaves Trojans after 11 seasons to lead Mustangs into ACC era |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/smu-hires-andy-enfield-usc-coach-leaves-trojans-after-11-seasons-to-lead-mustangs-into-acc-era/ |access-date=2024-04-15 |website=CBSSports.com |language=en}} On April 5, the school named [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas]] head coach [[Eric Musselman]] the team's new head coach.{{Cite web |last=Wilner |first=Jon |date=2024-04-05 |title=USC hires San Diego's Eric Musselman, and everything changes (everywhere) |url=https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/sports/college/story/2024-04-05/usc-hires-san-diegos-eric-musselman-and-everything-changes-everywhere |access-date=2024-04-15 |website=San Diego Union-Tribune |language=en-US}} The season marked the team's last season as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference]] before joining the [[Big Ten Conference]] on July 1, 2024. ==Previous season== The [[2022–23 USC Trojans men's basketball team|Trojans]] finished the [[2022–23 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2022–23 season]] 22–11, 14–6 in [[2022–23 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 Play]] to finish in a tie for second place. As the No. 3 seed in the [[2023 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]], they lost to the [[2022–23 Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball team|Arizona State]] in the quarterfinals. The Trojans received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 10 seed in the East.
